interpretation: Guided withheld two unsupported baseline PASS decisions but accepted none of the two clear positive pairs. Neither method is adequate for general acceptance; selected-case label agreement is not general reliability.
limits: Nine pairs come from three recordings in two original families; observations are correlated.
All labels and calibration are authored with two-agent review, not independent human ground truth.
Six of nine reference labels are UNKNOWN. An all-UNKNOWN system would match six while accepting no positive case.
New to this project does not establish absence from model training data.
The study uses prerecorded views, not continuous tracking, physical repair execution, hidden-state verification or validated demand.
Unmodified guided-v2 and direct Spark prompts differ; this is not a controlled ablation proving SAM itself caused a result.
Hashes and adapter provenance are local audit aids, not cryptographic provider attestation.
Reported costs are estimates rather than a provider billing or dollar hard stop.
